segments.thag5.3:1.1: “Vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ, channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā;
segments.thag5.3:1.3: Tassaṃ viharāmi vūpasanto, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
segments.thag5.3:2.1: “Vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ, channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā;
segments.thag5.3:2.3: Tassaṃ viharāmi santacitto, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
segments.thag5.3:3.1: “Vassati devo … pe … tassaṃ viharāmi vītarāgo … pe ….
segments.thag5.3:4.1: “Vassati devo … pe … tassaṃ viharāmi vītadoso … pe ….

lines: Tattha yathāsugītanti sugītānurūpaṃ, sundarassa attano meghagītassa anurūpamevāti attho.

Valāhako hi yathā agajjanto kevalaṃ vassanto na sobhati, evaṃ satapaṭalasahassapaṭalena uṭṭhahitvā thanayanto gajjanto vijjullatā nicchārentopi avassanto na sobhati, tathābhūto pana hutvā vassanto sobhatīti vuttaṃ “vassati devo yathāsugītan”ti.
“abhitthanaya, pajjunna”,(cariyā.3.89; jā.1.1.75)“gajjitā ceva vassitā cā”ti (a. ni.4.101; pu. pa.157) ca.
Tassaṃ viharāmīti tassaṃ kuṭikāyaṃ ariyavihāragabbhena iriyāpathavihārena viharāmi.
